retrieved.educational: • Evaluating RAG -the Retriever When the data is big and needs more accuracy we need to use recall same formula though. KEYOWRDS IN INTRO TO RAG VIDEO RAG (Retrieval -Augmented Generation): A system combining semantic search with generative AI to create dynamic responses. • It has two steps as follows; The system first searches a database or a collection of documents to find relevant information based on a user's q uery. It then uses a language model to generate a coherent response, incorporating the retrieved information.○• Semantic Search: A search technique that retrieves information based on the meaning of the query rather than exact keywords.• Generative AI: AI that generates text or content based on input prompts, such as GPT -4. A model that converts text into numerical vectors for easier processing and retrieval.• Cosine Similarity: A metric used to measure how similar two vectors are, often used in semantic search.• Few -Shot Learning: A technique where the model learns from a few examples to improve its performance.• Chain -of-Thought Prompting: A prompting technique where the model is guided to think through the steps before generating a response. A format used in prompts to structure the input for the AI model.• Precision: A metric that measures the relevance of retrieved documents out of all retrieved documents.• Recall: A metric that measures the ability to retrieve all relevant documents from a dataset.• Building a RAG Bot Retrieval: Fetching relevant information from a dataset using semantic search.• Index: A structure that stores embeddings for efficient retrieval.• Pinecone: A vector database used to store and query embeddings.• Cosine Similarity: A metric to measure the similarity between two vectors.• Metadata: Additional information stored with the text, such as URLs and dates.• Supabase: A database -as-a-service platform used to store token usage data. A wrapper class for interacting with OpenAI's GPT -4 model. Estimating the cost of using LLMs based on token usage.• Code for building a RAG Bot semanticse archragm... LLAMA 3 LLM Model used as an good alternative for rag Llama 3 is an open -source large language model (LLM) developed by Meta. • It is part of the Llama family of models, with the 8 billion parameter.• Llama 3 is designed to generate text and has been specifically trained to answer questions or hold conversations, making it s uitable for use in retrieval -augmented generation (RAG) systems. • DAY 4 Expanding into AI agents Definition of AI Agents: AI agents are generative AI systems with access to tools that allow them to perform actions, observe results, and respond based on those observations. • Thought, Action, Observation, Response Pattern:
